4448.title: Unbounded composer actions displace Send
4448.rootCauseOneLine: The host places plugin actions and Send in a non-wrapping, non-shrinking group without a width bound; wide plugin content pushes Send offscreen and overlaps left controls.
4448.proposedFix: Bound and wrap the host footer action group and individual plugin action mounts while preserving Send's non-shrinking control. All 18 browser layout/tap cases pass after this CSS repair.
4448.caveats: Verified with real host components and authored plugin contributions in two clean trusted checkouts; the original third-party plugin, physical Android keyboard and iOS Safari were not tested.
